final_topology.title: Government Segmented Network
final_topology.description: A network with distinct zones for standard and sensitive information systems, each with dedicated administrative infrastructure.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network includes a standard zone with a secure internet gateway and a sensitive zone isolated from the internet, both with their own administrative access points.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: Node n20 (Asset Inventory System) is linked to multiple nodes across different zones, indicating a centralized asset inventory system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: Node n21 (Data Flow Documentation System) is linked to multiple nodes across different zones, indicating a centralized data flow documentation system.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: Zones z1 (Standard Systems Zone) and z2 (Sensitive Systems Zone) are clearly separated, with dedicated administrative zones (z3 and z4) and firewalls (n1 and n2).

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: Nodes n1 (Secure Internet Gateway) and n2 (Class 1 Gateway) are firewalls, and they are linked to other nodes in their respective zones.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: Nodes n9 (DNS Server for Standard Systems) and n10 (DNS Server for Sensitive Systems) are linked to core switches (n7 and n8) in their respective zones.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: Node n14 (VPN Gateway for Remote Access) is linked to the Centralized AAA Server (n13), indicating MFA for remote access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: Node n11 (DNS Filtering Service) is linked to the Core Switch for Standard Systems (n7), indicating DNS filtering services are in place.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: Node n12 (Web Proxy for URL Filtering) is linked to the Core Switch for Standard Systems (n7), indicating URL filtering is enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The network is segmented into distinct zones (z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6, z7, z8, z9) with dedicated administrative and security infrastructure.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: Nodes n13 (Centralized AAA Server) and n15 (NAC/Compliance Check Node) are present, indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: Node n13 (Centralized AAA Server) is linked to multiple nodes, indicating centralized AAA management.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: Node n14 (VPN Gateway for Remote Access) is linked to the Centralized AAA Server (n13), indicating remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: Nodes n5 (IDS/IPS for Standard Systems) and n6 (IDS/IPS for Sensitive Systems) are present and linked to core switches (n7 and n8), indicating intrusion detection solutions are deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: Firewalls (n1 and n2) and IDS/IPS (n5 and n6) are present and linked to core switches (n7 and n8), indicating traffic filtering between segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: Node n15 (NAC/Compliance Check Node) is linked to the Core Switch for Standard Systems (n7), indicating access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: Node n16 (SIEM for Flow Logs) is linked to the IDS/IPS for Standard Systems (n5), indicating collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: Zone z5 (Non-Production Systems Zone) is separated from other zones, indicating a separate environment for non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: Node n19 (Penetration Testing Workstation) is linked to the Core Switch for Non-Production Systems (n18) and the Penetration Testing Service (n22), indicating periodic external penetration testing.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show an asset inventory system or process. However, it includes various nodes and zones that could be part of an inventory.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not include any explicit documentation of data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No documentation of data flows is present.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant nodes and zones.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not include any explicit indication of periodic external penetration testing.
findings_before.missing_reason: No evidence of periodic external penetration testing is present.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to relevant nodes and zones.
